fusions.name: Silvered Skein
fusions.desc: Sends a strand into the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Cast and Reel
fusions.desc: A thrown line that deals 14 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range, and stuns the target for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Slip the Knot
fusions.desc: Removes 2 conditions from you and increases your movement speed by 25% for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Cut Loose
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 35%, the cords around you slacken into a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
